urdu.name: میمون
urdu.long_meaning: Maymun (میمون) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم مبارک، بابرکت، خوش نصیب ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: میمون

faq.q: What is the origin of Maymun?
faq.a: Maymun is associated with Arabic. Maymun is Arabic مَيْمُون (Maymūn) 'blessed, fortunate, auspicious', from the root ي م ن (y-m-n). The source gloss 'Beloved' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as maymuna.
Yes — the underlying form ميمون is Arabic.
Maymun can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Maymun mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Maymun is rendered میمون and carries the sense مبارک، بابرکت، خوش نصیب.

faq.q: What does Maymun mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Maymun is rendered میمون and carries the sense مبارک، فرخنده، خجسته.
A romanized syllable approximation is may-mun. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Maymun?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Maymun, maymun. Script forms are ميمون, میمون, मैमून.

faq.q: Is Maymun a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
